body.text: Yes to all: (1) it strips surrounding whitespace and returns 'Hello, NAME!', (2) raises ValueError for empty string or whitespace-only name, and (3) return format is exactly 'Hello, {stripped_name}!'. In test_greet.py you can do 'from greet import greet' or 'import greet', both work as greet.py defines greet(name: str) -> str.
